verdict.rationale: Loops is an email/marketing SaaS platform, not an AI agent — the evidence shows Loops publishing its own MCP server so other agents can call ITS tools (loops-docs-6, loops-probe-4), which is the server role, not Loops acting as a client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain their tools. There is no agentic/assistant capability within Loops that could consume external MCP servers, so this axis is a category error for this product.
